ICS 621.631 - 83ETD 32Revised Standard from Last Update.1. SCOPE1.1 This Standard covers the performance requirements for single phase 50 Hz a.c. ceiling fans driven by squirrel cage induction motor, capacitor type and brushless d.c. motor fans up to and including 250 V for household and similar purposes.NOTES1 The provision of speed regulator operated manually or using remote control device is optional unless demanded by the buyer or user.2 For the purpose of testing by the inspecting and/or testing authority and/or the buyer, the manufacture shall ensure that the required fan/speed regulator compatible with the fan are supplied along with the fans under testing.1.2 The requirements for safety have been covered in IS 302 (Part 2/Sec 80).2. REFERENCESThe standards given below contain provisions which, through reference in this text, constitute provisions of this standard. At the time of publication, the editions indicated were valid.
